background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. CET1 of 13.2% is in the bottom quarter of UK majors, but leverage of 5.6% and NSFR of 143% are in the top quarter and LCR of 160% is above the peer median, so the balance sheet is better than the risk-weighted figure alone suggests. Liquidity has come down, with LCR down 26 points and NSFR down 8 points since 30 Jun 2025, while CET1 and leverage have been broadly flat. Flagged news in the last 90 days centres on planned job cuts in the UK wealth business, the newest on 10 Oct 2026, which is a cost matter rather than a credit one.
